parole.significato: Cucumis melo var. flexuosus, a slender, long, ligh green fruit from the melon family; Armenian cucumber, snake cucumber…
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish آجور (acur, “a kind of cucumber”), shares common origin with Arabic عَجُّور (ʕajjūr), derived from Byzantine Greek ἀγγούριν (angoúrin), derived from Ancient Greek άγγος (ángos).

parole.significato: steelyard, or a scale in general
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish قنطار (kantar), from Arabic قِنْطَار (qinṭār), from Byzantine Greek κεντηνάριον (kentēnárion), from Latin centēnārium.

parole.significato: parsley, any bright green, biennial herb of the species Petroselinum crispum
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish معدنوز (maydanoz), a medieval borrowing from Arabic مَعْدُونِس (maʕdūnis), from Byzantine Greek μακεδονήσιον (makedonḗsion, “parsley”). From Ottoman Turkish مندیل (mendil), from Arabic مَنْدِيل (mandīl), from Byzantine Greek μανδίλιον (mandílion), μαντίλιον (mantílion), or μανδήλη (mandḗlē, “cloth, hand towel, handkerchief, tablecloth”), from Latin mantēlium, mantēle (“cloth, hand towel, handkerchief, tablecloth”).

parole.significato: large water container with a handle, like a bucket or pail, made of copper or similar metal
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish ستیل (sitil, “large bucket or pail”), from Arabic سَطِل (saṭil, “bucket, pail”), from Byzantine Greek σίτλα (sítla, “bucket”), ultimately from Latin situla (“bucket”).
